Meeting Summary

Q3 Planning — Product / Engineering / Ops Sync

2026-08-27 · Attendees: Priya (PM), Marcus (Eng lead), Jenna (Ops), Dan (Design), Sara (VP Product)

Task: Summarize the meeting transcript as bullet points covering the key decisions/points and the next steps / action items.

Key Decisions & Points

  • Reconciliation revamp is the Q3 anchor. Current engine chokes on multi-currency batches — three incidents this quarter, support tickets up 40% QoQ. Build wins over buy: Recur ($180K/yr) and LedgerFlow ($140K, no jurisdiction-specific tax codes) both still require ~3 engineer-weeks of integration. In-house rewrite scoped at ~6 engineer-weeks, including FX rounding migration; needs Karim (platform) for 2 weeks on ledger integration.
  • Mobile receipt-capture ships v1 without bulk-select. Design flows complete, prototype tested with six users. User testing surfaced two asks: bulk-select before upload and a more prominent OCR confidence indicator. Bulk-select (~1 sprint) is deferred as a fast-follow to protect the reconciliation timeline.
  • Vendor payout SLA target: 48h p95 by mid-Q3 (current p95: 71h). Path is a shorter ACH batching window (12h → 4h) plus a second ops approver on the west-coast shift. Trade-off analysis needed before committing — decision gated on SRE sign-off on added monitoring load; if not manageable, fall back to intermediate targets.
  • Audit-log retention update pushed to Q4 (confirmed with Legal).
  • Internal admin-tool refresh stays with the intern crew — no changes.
  • Engineering bug-bash burnout flagged by HR — a lightweight rotating on-call structure will be proposed.

Next Steps / Action Items

  • Marcus Sync with Karim's manager this week to confirm his 2-week availability for the reconciliation rewrite.
  • Marcus Pair with Jenna on the ACH batching-window trade-off analysis; bring back next week with SRE input.
  • Marcus Propose a rotating on-call structure — due Aug 31.
  • Dan Update mobile receipt-capture specs (v1 without bulk-select; add fast-follow note) — due Wednesday.
  • Jenna Partner with Marcus on the ACH trade-off analysis.
  • Priya Circulate Q3 scope draft Thursday morning for review before Friday lock.
  • Sara Take Q3 scope to Monday exec review.
